scope: Constant-panel, midpoint-collocation 2-D Laplace prototype. These cases are narrow verification tests and do not validate general exterior flow, free-surface conditions, or 3-D ship flow.

translating_cylinder_added_mass.note: The polygon approximates the circular body. Added mass uses the computed boundary flux in the boundary energy integral. For this first angular mode, the bounded-domain flux trace matches the exterior fluid-normal trace; this does not validate a general exterior-domain solver.
